<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 5"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Fierce Grasp](/Feats.aspx?ID=5307) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Awakened Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=787" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 26

**Prerequisites**
[Climbing Animal](/Heritages.aspx?ID=288) heritage

**Requirements**
You have an opponent [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90).

</column>

---

Once you get your hands on someone, it's hard for them to get away. Your opponent takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their next attempt to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) from being grabbed or restrained by you, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your AC against any attacks they make against you while you have them grabbed.
name: Fierce Grasp
requirement: You have an opponent  grabbed  or  restrained .
